player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid format; please submit your guess as “[<number>]”.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pɩwɛɛ se ɛmaɣzɩ nɛ ɛna yɔ, pɩwɛ {min_guess} nɛ {max_guess} pɛ-hɛkʋ taa.

message.round_guesses: Piloto 0 ŋɔŋa {guess0}; Piloto 1 ŋɔŋa {guess1}. Kɛɛbɛ lɛ, Tɛmɛlɩyɛ kɛɛkɛɛ: {target}.

outcome.draw: Pɩtɩŋa payɩ pɩ-taa lɛ, you ŋgʋ kɩtɩwɛɛkɩ.
